title: REFER: Mitigating Bias in Opinion Summarisation via Frequency Framed Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the proportional representation of Pro-Republican versus Pro-Democrat viewpoints in generated summaries of political tweets compared to the input source documents, using metrics such as Second-Order SPD (SPD), Binary Unfair Rate (BUR), Unfair Error Rate (UER), and Second-Order Fairness (SOF).

Evaluating the proportional representation of Pro-Positive versus Pro-Negative sentiments in generated summaries of Amazon product reviews against the original source distributions using various token-based and sentence-level fairness metrics.
